senses.gloss: भज् [cf. Gk. ϕαγεῖν, ϕᾱγός, ϕηγός; Lat. fāgus; Goth. Old S. bōk; Germ. Buch, Buch-stabe; Eng. buck-, beech.]
भाज् mfn. (mostly ifc.; exceptionally with gen.) sharing or participating in, entitled to, possessing, enjoying, perceiving, feeling, sensible of, devoted to, intent upon, Br. &c. &c.
forming a part of, belonging to, RPrāt.
joined or connected with, liable to, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
occupying, inhabiting, frequenting, dwelling or living in or on Kāv.; MārkP.
going or resorting to, falling into, seeking, Ragh.; Kir.
revering, worshipping, Bhag.; Ragh.
what is due, duty, concern (= कर्तव्य), Bhaṭṭ.
भाज् भाजन. See col. 1.
भजक m. a distributer, apportioner (see चीवर-भ्˚)
a worshipper, MW.
भाजक m. (fr. Caus.) a divisor (in arithm.), Col.
भ˚जन m. N. of a prince, VP.
भ˚जन n. the act of sharing, W.
possession, ib.
भ˚जन n. (ifc.) reverence, worship, adoration, Prab., Sch. (also -ता f. with loc. Cāṇ.)
भा॑जन n. (fr. Caus.) sharing, division (in arithm.), Col.
भा॑जन mf(आ)n. (ifc.) sharing or participating in, entitled or relating or belonging to, Br. &c. &c.
भा॑जन n. ‘partaker of’, a recipient, receptacle, (esp.) a vessel, pot, plate, cup, &c., MBh.; Kāv. &c.
भा॑जन n. (with gen. or ifc. with f(आ). ), a place or person in which anything is collected or in whom any quality is conspicuous, any fit object or clever or deserving person, ib. (cf. पात्र)
भा॑जन n. the act of representing, representation (˚नेन ind. with gen. in the place of; ifc. a representative, deputy, substitute, serving for, equivalent to), Br.; GṛS.
भा॑जन n. a partic. measure (= an Āḍhaka = 14 Palas), ŚārṅgS.
भा॑जन m. N. of a man
भा॑जन m. pl. his descendants g. बिदादि.
भ˚जन—ता f., with loc. Cāṇ.
भाजन—ता f. (ifc.) the being a vessel for, possession of BhP.
भ˚जन—वारिक m. a partic. official in a Buddhist monastery, L.
भाजन—वारिक m. a vessel-keeper, Divyāv. (cf. -चारिका).
भ˚ज˚नानन्द m. N. of an author, Cat.
भ˚ज˚नामृत n. N. of wk.
भ˚जनीय mfn. to be loved or revered or waited upon, venerable, MBh.; BhP.
भ˚जमान mfn. apportioning &c., MBh.
fitting, meet, appropriate, L.
N. of various princes, Hariv.; Pur.
भ˚जि m. N. of a prince (also ˚जिन् and ˚जिन), ib.
भाजी f. rice-gruel (= श्राणा), Pāṇ. iv, 1, 42 (= पङ्क-व्यञ्जन-विशेष, Vop., Sch.)
भ˚जितव्य (MBh.) mfn. = ˚जनीय.
भ˚जेन्य (BhP.) mfn. = ˚जनीय.
भ˚ज्य (Vop.) mfn. = ˚जनीय.
भाज्य mfn. to be shared or distributed &c.
(in arithm.) to be divided, as subst. = a dividend, Siddhāntaś.
भज-गोविन्द-स्तोत्र n. N. of wk. (cf. भगवद्-गोविन्द).
भजे॑रथ RV. x, 60, 2 (Padap. भजे + अरथ), prob. भजे॑ (inf.) or भ॑जे (1. sg. fr. √ भज्) + र॑थस्य.
भा॑जनेन ind., with gen. in the place of; ifc. a representative, deputy, substitute, serving for, equivalent to
भाजन—चारिक v.l. (or w.r.) for -वारिक, q.v.
भाजन—त्व n. the being a fit vessel for (gen.), merit, worthiness, Mālav.
भाजन—लोक m. (with Buddhists) the world of inanimate things (opp. to सत्त्व-ल्˚, q.v.), Dharmas. 89.
भाजन—वत् mfn. a word used to explain भद्र, Nir. iv, 10 &c.
भाजनी-भूत mfn. (ifc.) one who has become a vessel for or who has obtained, Kathās.; Lalit.
भाजयु mfn. (fr. Caus.) sharing with others, generous, liberal, RV.
भाजा f. = वक्र-यष्टि, Gaṇar. (cf. Pāṇ. iv, 1, 42).
भाजित mfn. (fr. Caus.) shared, divided, Sūryas.
distributed, portioned, W.
भाजित n. a share, portion, ib.
भाजिन् mfn. (ifc.) sharing, participating in ChUp.; Kum.
connected with, Kām.
भाजक् ind. (g. चादि) quickly, swiftly, L.
